deviation: GIT_ASKPASS alone was assumed to drive authentication

response: measured: GCM sets credential.interactive=false; the working form is credential.helper= + credential.interactive=always + core.askPass=<.cmd wrapper>
reusable_rule: RULE: verify the credential MECHANISM separately from the credential VALUE
